name: lps
description: LPS — index of installed and running programs for Debian/Ubuntu

scripts.build:web: bun build src/web/index.tsx --outdir dist/web --target browser --minify --entry-naming "[name].[ext]" --asset-naming "[name].[ext]" && cp src/web/public/index.html dist/web/ && cp node_modules/primereact/resources/themes/lara-light-blue/theme.css dist/web/theme-light.css && cp node_modules/primereact/resources/themes/lara-dark-blue/theme.css dist/web/theme-dark.css && mkdir -p dist/web/fonts && cp node_modules/primereact/resources/themes/lara-light-blue/fonts/InterVariable*.woff2 dist/web/fonts/
scripts.build: prisma generate && bun run build:web && bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --asset ./dist/web --outfile dist/lps
